question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the crowd activity at DemoBooth_NVIDIA versus DemoBooth_Intel. Which booth was busier, and approximately what was the ratio of their average head_counts?
answer_text:
DemoBooth_NVIDIA was busier on 2025-12-08 (UTC): average head_count 15.515000000000002 for camera_location "DemoBooth_NVIDIA" (hour_utc range 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-09T00:00:00Z) versus 10.64833333333333 for camera_location "DemoBooth_Intel" (same hour_utc range).  
The NVIDIA/Intel average head_count ratio is 1.4570355298168733 (total_samples_nvidia 86400, total_samples_intel 86400).

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_nvidia, sum(ch.event_count) AS samples_nvidia
}
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_Intel'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_intel, sum(ch.event_count) AS samples_intel
}
RETURN avg_nvidia AS avg_head_count_nvidia,
       avg_intel AS avg_head_count_intel,
       CASE WHEN avg_intel IS NULL OR avg_intel = 0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_nvidia / avg_intel END AS nvidia_over_intel_avg_hc_ratio,
       samples_nvidia AS total_samples_nvidia,
       samples_intel AS total_samples_intel
